mapper.sql: id, agent_key, secret_hash, store_id, hostname, platform, version, ip, server_url, config_revision, registered_at, last_seen_at
mapper.select: SELECT store_id, COUNT(*) AS total, SUM(CASE WHEN last_seen_at >= #{onlineSince} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS online FROM log_agent GROUP BY store_id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO log_agent (agent_key, secret_hash, store_id, hostname, platform, version, ip, server_url, config_revision, registered_at, last_seen_at) VALUES (#{agent.agentKey}, #{agent.secretHash}, #{agent.storeId}, #{agent.hostname}, #{agent.platform}, #{agent.version}, #{agent.ip}, #{agent.serverUrl}, #{agent.configRevision}, #{agent.registeredAt}, #{agent.lastSeenAt})
mapper.update: UPDATE log_agent SET secret_hash = #{agent.secretHash}, store_id = #{agent.storeId}, hostname = #{agent.hostname}, platform = #{agent.platform}, version = #{agent.version}, ip = #{agent.ip}, server_url = #{agent.serverUrl}, config_revision = #{agent.configRevision}, registered_at = #{agent.registeredAt}, last_seen_at = #{agent.lastSeenAt} WHERE id = #{agent.id}
